note: Synthetic TEST vectors for the witness-only certificate check (T-1322). The same file, byte for byte, sits in the TypeScript, Python and Go test folders; each SDK's test pins the file's sha256. `vectors`: every entry goes through the SDK's verifyEd25519 primitive (keys derived from a public label, so they are test keys). `precheck_vectors`: the expected result of the SDK's own key / signature-encoding check, before any crypto library is called. `small_order_y`: the seven small-order y values (sign bit cleared) — the SDK's list must be exactly this set. `certificate_field_vectors`: one signature text field of a base certificate fixture is replaced and the certificate goes through verifyCertificate. `version_field_vectors`: one version field is replaced by a JSON token (or removed); four expected columns because the SDKs do not all receive the same thing. Base v2 = cert-valid-anchored.json with the test witness key, base v3 = the recorded v3 certificate with the production witness public key.
